exposure: caesarean section in second stage of labor
cohort: 200 patients undergoing caesarean section at full cervical dilatation at a tertiary care hospital in Gaya, Bihar, India
finding: Caesarean sections during the second stage of labor are associated with significant maternal morbidity, including PPH (13.5%), post-operative wound infection (6%), and post-operative fever (16%), as well as neonatal morbidity including NICU admission (5.5%), nursery admission (13%), jaundice (12.5%) and neonatal death (1%).
